To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

metformin and fibrate combination therapy is effective and safe for improving insulin sensitivity in patients with simple non-diabetic obesity and that metformin is effective in patients with type 2 diabetes.
fenofibrate and metformin combination treatment is more effective than metformin alone in improving insulin sensitivity and β-cell function in simple obesity with insulin resistance.
fenofibrate combined with metformin can improve peripheral insulin sensitivity and β-cell function, and reduce fasting insulin level in obese subjects with hyperinsulineamia.

the study of the molecular mechanism of insulin resistance in obesity.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
metformin and fibrates are useful for the treatment of insulin resistance in obesity.
metformin and fibrate therapy is a useful adjunct to lifestyle intervention for the treatment of simple obesity.
fenofibrate and metformin combination therapy may be a promising treatment strategy for patients with insulin resistance in obesity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
fenofibrate is effective in reducing insulin resistance, and this effect may be enhanced when combined with metformin.
the combined treatment with fenofibrate and metformin was superior to metformin alone in improving insulin resistance and glucose tolerance.
metformin and/or fenofibrate can be used for treatment of insulin resistance in patients suffering from simple obesity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of metformin and fibrate can be used as a safe, effective and inexpensive alternative to other drugs in the treatment of insulin resistance.
